architecture: Frozen validation-selected LC epoch7; warm-start trainable patch encoder; two position-aware 96D four-head attention blocks; zero-initialized bounded spatial correction
augmentation: two query-only brightness/contrast/gamma views, independent uniform [.8,1.2]; seed addressed; one frozen dense pass
bank_policy: 18 unique training photos from pinned NB10; full source SHA self-reference exclusion and 6/n_allowed reference-class scale; all386 queries
bank_risks: paint/glare/identity shortcuts remain; reference diversity does not create independent tyres
context_attention: Full selected/final identity matrices CSV/native; per-head summaries for every observation; no full per-update matrix retention
diagnostic_scope: all selected/final endpoint images; no diagnostic-based checkpoint selection
objective: paired CE + .1 probability JS + .05 contextual-embedding distance + .02 squared bounded total correction
representation: masked local9x9 z/std floor.02 clipped3, Sobel x/y/magnitude; four channels
sampler: uniform class/domain; group probability proportional sqrt(n); uniform image within group; replacement; 386 training queries
schedule: cosine over 2940 completed optimizer updates; no warmup
selection: maximum validation observed-ground-truth-class BA (low/high), then minimum three-class NLL, then earliest epoch; no test selection
test_role: 103 previously inspected historical test images; existing-cohort development only
